shared_elements: low relief carved in pale stone
horizontal registers separated by patterned bands
repeated small ornamental units forming a decorative border
justification: Both surfaces organise low-relief imagery into stacked horizontal registers divided by bands of repeating ornament, with profile quadrupeds, upright human figures and a foliage/tree motif occupying the fields — a genuinely comparable compositional logic. But the manner is quite different: A is a narrow, isolated pillar with a few large, blocky, schematic creatures in bold projecting relief, whereas B is an expansive wall covered with many small, finely modelled, evenly spaced figures in shallow, orderly procession.
